Description: Short name of the dataset or file the data was extracted from, used for identification of different datasets within the database
ISO8601 datetime on which sample was taken, as reported by the data source (note entries without a day have been assigned 01/mm/yyyy and entries without a time have been assigned 00:00:00)
Latitude of sampling position decimalised (-90° to 90° where negative values indicate latitudes South of the equator and positive ones indicate those North of it)
Longitude of sampling position decimalised (-180° to 180°, where negative values indicate longitudes West of the Prime Meridian, and positive values indicate longitudes East of it)
The sensor derived temperature of the sample, ITS-90
QC flag for the temperature (included where present)
CTD/sensor derived pressure of the sample
Comments: Some samples may have both pressure and depth but should have a minimum of one or the other, should be assumed to be a surface measurement where not present in freshwater samples

Description: Depth value derived from the CTD pressure and latitude using the following function (implemented in python) https://www.teos-10.org/pubs/gsw/html/gsw_z_from_p.html
Depth (meters below surface) at which samples were taken, increases positively with increasing depth below water's surface
Comments: Should be assumed to be a surface measurement where not present in freshwater samples

Description: Combined column of Depth_From_Pressure and Sample_Depth; where both are present, Depth_From_Pressure takes precedence
Comments: Should be assumed to be a surface measurement where not present in freshwater samples

Description: The delta O18 measurement of a sample as compared to the reference standard listed in the "O18 standard" column
The WOCE flag for the DELO18 column measurement datasets with non standard flags have been translated into their WOCE alternative (included where present)
Comments: Datasets where non-standard WOCE flags have been used (and the meanings provided) have been translated into their WOCE equivelants

Description: The WOCE flag for the DELO18 column measurement, here datasets with non-standard flags have been left as they were originally listed (included where present)

The specified standard against which the O18 measurement was taken, any data entry for which the O18 Standard could not  be found is labelled as "VSMOW (assumed)", the standard for the entries cannot be found and should therefore be treated as VSMOW but treated with caution
The Barium measurement of a sample
The WOCE flag for the Barium column measurement
Units that the associated Barium measurement was reported in
The sensor/CTD derived salinity of a sample
Comments: All non-freshwater samples should contain a CTD or bottle salinity value

Description: WOCE flag for the sensor derived salinity (included where present)
The bottle derived salinity for a sample
Comments: All non-freshwater samples should contain a CTD or bottle salinity value

Description: WOCE flag for the bottle derived salinity (included where present)
The cruise name or ID on which the samples were taken
The unique identifier for the station at which the samples were taken
The unique identifier for the site at which the samples were taken (only present for land based sampling)
The unique identifier for the sample taken
The cast number the sample was measured in
The bottle number the sample was measured in
A unique identifier similar to "Sample ID" that marks the event
An identifier for the position of a bottle on the CTD rosette
The name or identifier of a platform from which sampling was taken
A boolean flag to mark whether a sample was take on a study associated with (but not funded by) the BIOPOLE campaign (True), or not (False)
A boolean flag to mark whether a sample is freshwater (True) or not (False)
A short description of the type of freshwater source for freshwater samples e.g "River"

Geographic flag indicating whether the sample location falls on land rather than ocean. Determined using a high-resolution (10 m) global coastline dataset and a point-in-polygon spatial test (Shapely/GEOS). TRUE where the sample’s latitude/longitude intersects land polygons; FALSE otherwise. Used for distinguishing terrestrial samples, river mouths, and shoreline artefacts from open-water observations.
Comments: Please note, while effective this is an approximate method and should be treated with caution and manual inspection should be applied where nessecary.
